sb_hint: AP pool = total points for character creation (e.g. 1100). attrBase = free starting value; only above it does each point cost AP per the cost curve (e.g. up to 14 at 15 AP each). Caps bound maxima (single value, total, skills). fatePoints = starting fate points. Example: 1100 AP, attrBase 8, maxAttrValue 20, maxSkillValue 20.
sb_curve: Default cost curve (up to value → AP per point)
sb_save_blocked: Over budget — reduce costs before saving
st_hint: Catalog of advantages/disadvantages with costs per tier (tier → AP). Effects apply automatically once the trait is chosen: derived:hp + add + 3 grants +3 hit points, attribute:strength +1 raises the attribute. requires/excludes govern combinations; description shows as a sheet tooltip.
sa_hint: Costs per column and target value. Skills pick a column; activation costs apply at value 0. Columns (A/B/…) are pure price tiers: table with from/to plus costs per column — each skill references exactly one.
v_need_attributes: Add at least one attribute before saving
s2_hint: Define your system’s core attributes (e.g. Strength). The name is free — uppercase and accents are allowed. In formulas (e.g. 1d20+strength) names are compared case-insensitively but must not contain spaces or brackets; lowercase without special characters is just the safe convention. Min/Max/Default bound the value and the sheet default.
sdv_hint: Define values calculated automatically from attributes (e.g. hit points) — as a formula (e.g. (constitution+strength)/2+5) or a table (input sum → value). The formula builder inserts attributes as @{name} — equivalent to bare names (@{mut} = mut); allowed: + - * / ( ), floor(), min()/max(), round(). With requiresTrait the value only applies with that trait (e.g. astral points for spellcasters only). Derived values appear on the character sheet and drive probe thresholds, combat targets and resource maxima.
s5a_hint: Active abilities have a cost (number + type AP/MP), optionally an action type and a dice expression for damage/effect; the damage type drives resistances. Passive abilities carry a bonus text (e.g. +1 to armor) shown on the sheet. Maneuvers like Mighty Blow (weapon damage +x, attack penalty) belong in Dice → Maneuvers.
s6_hint: This controls advancement. At the top (Basic step) pick progressionType: level = level table, xp = points per improvement, improvement = improvement rolls (skill +1 on success). The matrix applies to all: cost per column and target value; each skill references one column.
s6_level_hint: Define experience points and features per level.
s6_xp_hint: Define how much XP improving individual skills costs. The columns (e.g. A/B) are cost curves from the advancement matrix — each skill picks its column there (“talent (A)” = curve A).
s6_imp_hint: Define skills improved via advancement rolls: successful roll → +1 skill value (or table value). No entries means no random advancement.
s7_magic_hint: Optional block for magic and psionics — leave empty if your system has none (only what you fill in is saved). Mana formula = derived value for the maximum (e.g. mana from attributes), spell slots as slots; schools/disciplines are free lists.
s7_psionics_hint: Define the basics of your psionics system.
s8_hint: Conditionals are automatic bonuses/penalties when a condition holds (e.g. “Strength > 15 → +1 damage”). Conditions are active effects on the character (e.g. “Wound”) that apply immediately and continuously while active: probe/damage modifiers, optional round duration, and blocked actions. They show as chips on the sheet.
s3_hint: Skills are tied to one or more attributes: skill value = rule bonus + sum of attribute modifiers (per-character values override the rule bonus). Derived values (attack/parry) work the other way round: in the Values step define e.g. at_swords = Swords + floor((str-8)/3) — the formula reads the skill. kind (combat/craft/social/…) only groups.
s4_probe_hint: The probe expression sets the dice system: 1d20+mod (reach target), 1d100 (≤ skill value), 3d20 (each ≤ attribute). The probeType in the Basic step is derived from it unless you set it — so the expression here is usually enough.
s4_ap_hint: AP (Action Points): Each combat action costs AP. AP Standard = AP per round, AP Max = maximum storable AP (e.g. for saving up). Typical: 2 Standard / 4 Max.
spk_hint: Packages bundle attribute mods, auto-traits and AP costs. Example species “Elf”: STR +1, “CON,SIZ” −1 by choice, 18 AP, auto-trait “Night vision”. Choice = player choice (“STR,CON” or “*” for free). baseValues are free floors (e.g. “Swords 5”) — only advancing above them costs AP. recommended/restricted are hints only.
s8_states_hint: Conditions from the catalog apply immediately and always while active: probe effects as penalty/bonus on probes, damage on damage. Rounds tick in combat on the bearer's turn (no rounds: permanent until removed). blocks locks action types in combat (e.g. ATTACK, MOVE, DEFEND, MANEUVER, ABILITY). Conditions are assigned manually (character sheet/DM), by combat/social effects or adventures — there are no prerequisites: whoever has it, feels it.
s8_social_hint: Skill probe + relationship modifier; success/failure applies conditions to the target (ADR-013).
s4_attack_hint: Optional: attack must reach the defender’s target value or no damage is dealt.
s4_difficulties_hint: Optional named levels (× = multiplier, Δ = shift).
s4_resting_hint: Short and long rest per system: Heal % is a fraction of maximum from 0 to 1 (0.5 = half), full heal restores everything. Recover additionally refills resources (mana/slots) per their restore rule (short/long). Without config, resting does nothing — set at least one option.
s3_description_hint: Explains the skill to players on the character sheet.
st_description_hint: Explains to players what the trait does rules-wise.
spk_autotraits_hint: Prefer picking traits from the list above (dropdown suggestions).
s2_description_hint: Explains the attribute on the character sheet.
sdv_description_hint: Explains the value to players on the character sheet.
v_pkg_cost: Package {{index}}: cost must be an integer
rename_confirm: Another system already uses this name. Rename anyway?
s5a_costtype_hint: Cost type: AP = action points, MP = mana/psionics
s5a_bonus_hint: Passive bonus as text, e.g. +1 to armor
s4_maneuvers_hint: Weapon damage +x against an attack penalty and/or AP cost — e.g. Mighty Blow: damage +2, attack −2.
s3_derive_body:
Skill value = rule bonus + sum of attribute modifiers; per-character values override the rule bonus. Derived values like attack/parry are defined in the Values step as a formula that reads the skill name:
at_swords = Swords + floor((str-8)/3)
pa_swords = floor(Swords/2)
Formulas are case-insensitive; on a name collision the attribute wins. So: create skill Swords here, then add two entries with these formulas in the Values step.
